channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula entrega títulos de terra e destina R$ 20 mi a assentamentos no MS
item.description: President Lula delivered 1,390 land titles to settled families in Mato Grosso do Sul and announced R$20 million in investments to improve productive infrastructure, grain storage, and energy transition in settlements across Ponta Porã, Bataguassu, Bela Vista, Corumbá, Amambai, Aquidauana, Sidrolândia, Itaquiraí, Rio Brilhante, Corguinho, and Nova Alvorada do Sul. He also released PAA contracts for local cooperatives and signed a tax transaction with Grupo João Santos to settle federal debts through land delivery for agrarian reform.

item.title: Família Bolsonaro tenta pacificar racha público após atrito por palanque
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro publicly denied the existence of a family rift following a political disagreement over a campaign platform, stating that rumors of offenses are unfounded and that family relations remain intact.

item.title: Ex-ministro de Lula assume liderança da Maioria na Câmara
item.description: Former Minister of Ports and Airports Silvio Costa Filho (Republicanos-PE) was chosen to assume the leadership of the Majority in the Chamber of Deputies, articulated by House President Hugo Motta. The position, representing the largest parliamentary bloc (300 deputies), will take effect next week after a leaders’ meeting. Although he had planned to run for Senate in Pernambuco on João Campos’ ticket, the final alliance arrangement excluded him, favoring Humberto Costa (PT) and Marília Arraes (PDT).

item.title: Itamaraty confirma morte de dois brasileiros após terremotos na Venezuela
item.description: Itamaraty confirmed the deaths of two Brazilian citizens following earthquakes of magnitudes 7.2 and 7.5 that struck Venezuela on Wednesday night (24), resulting in 188 fatalities and 1,520 injured. President Lula announced Brazil will send a humanitarian mission with 36 firefighters, civil defense and ANATEL technicians, and nine tons of equipment via a KC-390 aircraft from Guarulhos on Friday (26). On Saturday (27), a plane will deliver supplies to set up a field hospital, solar-powered water purifiers, medicines, and surgical materials.

item.title: Espriella defende cooperação com Brasil após eleição
item.description: Colombia's president-elect, Abelardo de la Espriella, stated he will maintain cooperative relations with Brazil following his electoral victory. The declaration was made on social media in response to a congratulatory message from Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Em nome de que Michelle desafiou a autoridade de Bolsonaro?
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro published a video explaining why she will not support Flávio Bolsonaro in his candidacy, signaling a possible familial rift within the Bolsonarist core. More than the video’s content, the act raises questions about her political independence and the future of the movement’s leadership after Jair Bolsonaro. This suggests a potential reconfiguration of alliances within Brazil’s right wing in 2026.

item.title: Esquerda se junta a Michelle contra Flávio em grupos e ofusca crise do governo Lula
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro released two videos on her social media criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for president, intensifying internal divisions within Bolsonarismo. The backlash gained traction on WhatsApp and Telegram, where left-wing groups began supporting Michelle to undermine Flávio, temporarily overshadowing the Lula government's crisis in digital discourse.

item.title: O que está em disputa entre Flávio e Michelle Bolsonaro é o futuro, a partir de 2030
item.description: Andreazza argues that the conflict between Flávio and Michelle Bolsonaro transcends personal grievances and represents a struggle over the future of bolsonarism after 2030, when Jair Bolsonaro will no longer serve as the unifying figure. Michelle presents herself as the defender of the movement’s purist legacy, while Flávio seeks to broaden his appeal, particularly among women, which his stepchildren view as a betrayal of Jair’s political patrimony.

item.title: Transporte responde por 36,6% do consumo energético no Brasil
item.description: The transport sector accounts for 36.6% of Brazil's national energy consumption between 2014 and 2024, ranging from 35.42% to 37.85%, according to the ONTL/Infra S.A. report. Total national energy consumption rose from 279 to 308 million tep, while transport consumption increased from 101.1 to 116.5 million tep (+15%). Road transport dominates with 82.15% of sector energy use, reflecting heavy reliance on diesel oil.

item.title: Brasil mandará ajuda humanitária para Venezuela, diz Lula
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced Brazil will send a humanitarian mission to Venezuela to assist in search and rescue operations following earthquakes that left at least 188 dead. The mission includes 36 firefighters, national civil defense and ANATEL technicians, and 9 tons of equipment, with a second flight on Saturday delivering a field hospital, solar-powered water purifiers, and medical supplies. The decision followed a phone call with Venezuela’s interim president, Delcy Rodríguez, as an expression of solidarity.

item.title: Energia limpa não garante segurança do setor elétrico
item.description: The EPE’s 2026 National Energy Balance Synthesis Report shows that in 2025, Brazil’s electricity matrix reached 86.8% renewable participation, with wind and solar contributing 26.4% of total generation. Despite clean energy growth, experts warn that the intermittency of renewables poses a challenge to grid stability, which could be alleviated by upcoming battery storage auctions in December 2026. The Ministry of Mines and Energy states these auctions combine energy security, transition, and industrial policy.

item.title: Espriella responde Lula e defende união entre Brasil e Colômbia
item.description: Abelardo de la Espriella, elected president of Colombia for the 2026-2030 term, responded to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's message by advocating for a cooperative relationship between Brazil and Colombia. He emphasized that the American continent faces shared transnational challenges—such as Amazon preservation, organized crime, and poverty reduction—that require joint, respectful, and sovereign action, echoing Lula’s view that bilateral friendship transcends ideology.

item.title: Duas semanas após afastar sete superintendentes, novo presidente da CVM recompõe cargos
item.description: Two weeks after removing seven superintendents, the new CVM president Otto Lobo has reconstituted the agency's leadership, appointing career servants to most positions while planning to name an external candidate for the key Superintendência-Geral, pending presidential approval. Among the confirmed appointments is José Alexandre Vasco, Lobo's former personal advisor, now heading the Superintendence of Development and Institutional Modernization. The CVM declined to comment on the external appointment but noted the post has historically been politically appointed.

item.title: Michelle usou mesmo cenário da gravação contra Flávio Bolsonaro em outros conteúdos para o PL Mulher; relembre
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro used the same setting at the PL headquarters in Brasília—previously featured in PL Mulher videos—to record a critical video against her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The setting, filled with references to Jair Bolsonaro and religious items, indicates a calculated production rather than a spontaneous outburst. The video followed her public opposition to a potential PL-Ciro Gomes alliance in Ceará, sparking internal party tensions.

item.title: AGU defende a extradição de Carla Zambelli em Corte Italiana
item.description: The Attorney General's Office (AGU) filed a statement with Italy's Supreme Court of Cassation advocating for the extradition of Carla Zambelli, former federal deputy convicted by Brazil's STF for illegal firearm possession and illegal coercion. The case stems from her armed pursuit of a Lula supporter in 2022, and the AGU asserts her fundamental rights will be upheld in Brazil. A ruling from the Italian judiciary is expected in the coming weeks.

item.title: Brasil envia nesta sexta missão humanitária à Venezuela, anuncia Lula
item.description: President Lula announced that Brazil will send a humanitarian mission to Venezuela this Friday (26) to assist in search-and-rescue operations following two earthquakes that left 188 dead and over 40,000 missing. The mission includes 36 firefighters, civil defense and ANATEL technicians, and nine tons of equipment, with a second flight scheduled for Saturday carrying supplies to set up a field hospital, solar-powered water purifiers, medicines, and surgical materials.

item.title: Em encontro com embaixadores, Renan Santos critica Lula e sobra até para o clã Bolsonaro
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's pre-candidate for president, criticized Lula by calling him a 'China's lapdog' in foreign policy and described Bolsonarism as a 'boomer movement' tied to voters over 60 who 'have already given up'. He accused both candidates of being involved in corruption scandals, positioning himself as an anti-establishment alternative for young voters.

item.title: Em reunião com Lula, até Haddad se dispôs a ser vice em SP
item.description: In a meeting with Lula at the Palácio da Alvorada, Fernando Haddad, Simone Tebet, Marina Silva, and Márcio França all offered to run as vice-governor of São Paulo or for the Senate. Haddad, already chosen as the gubernatorial candidate, said he is open to being vice or senator if another name is better suited to lead the ticket. França, who initially considered running two left-wing gubernatorial candidates, reversed his view and also offered to be vice to avoid weakening the left in the race.

item.title: Crusoé: Bia Kicis lamenta vídeo de Michelle sobre Flávio: “Caiu como uma bomba”
item.description: Federal Deputy Bia Kicis (PL) stated that the video by former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL), in which she vented about criticism from Bolsonarists regarding her political activities, 'fell like a bomb'. Kicis said the video was not well received and caused a negative impact among supporters of former President Jair Bolsonaro. Her comment was made on Thursday, the 25th, in response to Michelle's post from Wednesday, the 24th.

item.title: Lula anuncia que enviará ajuda humanitária à Venezuela nesta sexta
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva announced Brazil will send humanitarian aid to Venezuela following two earthquakes that killed over 180 and injured 1,500. The first mission, departing from Guarulhos on Friday, includes 36 firefighters, civil defense and Anatel technicians, and nine tons of search-and-rescue equipment. A second flight on Saturday will deliver a field hospital, solar-powered water purifiers, medicines, and surgical supplies.

item.title: Não vi e nem vou ver, diz Ciro Gomes sobre vídeo de Michelle
item.description: Ciro Gomes said he has not seen and does not intend to watch the video posted by Michelle Bolsonaro regarding Flávio Bolsonaro. He characterized the matter as an internal issue of the PL party and stated it should not affect ongoing political articulations.

item.title: ‘Não vi e nem vou ver’, diz Ciro sobre vídeo de Michelle Bolsonaro contra Flávio
item.description: Ciro Gomes (PSDB), pre-candidate for governor of Ceará, stated he did not watch and does not intend to watch the video in which Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) criticizes Flávio Bolsonaro (RJ), saying the matter is an internal issue of the national PL and not related to their alliance in the state. He reiterated his focus on the emancipation project for Ceará, despite the Bolsonaro family dispute over support for Eduardo Girão (Novo) and tensions with Jair Bolsonaro’s sons.

item.title: Disputas familiares serão problema constante para candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro publicly accused her stepson, presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, of disrespect and mistreatment over the phone, sparking a family episode that exposed internal tensions within the Bolsonaro clan. Although he apologized publicly, the incident revealed strategic and leadership disputes within the PL, particularly after Michelle opposed a potential alliance with Ciro Gomes. Despite the setback, allies consider withdrawal unlikely, linking it only to a sharp drop in polls due to new scandals.

item.title: Pela 1ª vez em 3 meses, Petrobras vai importar diesel em julho
item.description: Petrobras will resume diesel imports in July for the first time in three months, as confirmed by President Magda Chambriard during an event with President Lula. The import is described as a temporary measure while the company works to boost domestic production and achieve diesel self-sufficiency. The event also marked the restart of construction on the UFN-III fertilizer plant in Três Lagoas (MS), a R$ 5 billion project expected to create 8,000 jobs and begin operations in 2029.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vai ao STF contra Janones após ser chamado de ‘miliciano’ e ‘bandido’
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a criminal complaint at the Supreme Federal Court against André Janones for alleged slander in social media videos where the deputy called him 'miliciano', 'bandido' and other offensive terms. The defense claims the content constitutes hate speech and seeks at least R$200,000 in moral damages, citing a prior defamation conviction as precedent. The case rapporteur has not yet been assigned.

item.title: Lula conversa com Delcy Rodríguez e anuncia envio de missão humanitária à Venezuela
item.description: President Lula announced the deployment of two Brazilian Air Force humanitarian missions to Venezuela following earthquakes that left over 180 dead and 1,500 injured. A KC-390 aircraft departed on Friday the 26th with firefighters, technicians, and search-and-rescue equipment, with another plane scheduled for Saturday the 27th carrying field hospital supplies, solar water purifiers, and medical materials. The initiative aims to support Venezuela in its humanitarian crisis, focusing on La Guaira, declared a disaster zone.

item.title: Vídeo de Michelle gerou sete vezes mais engajamento que crise de Jaques Wagner
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro's video about her conflict with Flávio Bolsonaro generated seven times more engagement than the Jacques Wagner scandal, with 1.4 million interactions versus 214,000, according to Instituto Democracia em Xeque. Her content also garnered 91,600 mentions compared to 29,300 for the senator, rapidly shifting the public agenda. Both incidents caused political damage: Wagner's case centered on Operation Compliance Zero and Banco Master allegations, while Michelle's video amplified debates on Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-candidacy and internal divisions within Bolsonarism.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula entrega obras de aeroportos concedidos no MS
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva attends the inauguration of renovations at three airports in Mato Grosso do Sul—Ponta Porã, Corumbá, and Campo Grande—with particular emphasis on the construction of jet bridges at Campo Grande’s airport. The upgrades, carried out by concessionaire Aena Brasil following the 7th Airport Concessions Round by Anac, were financed by the BNDES using public funds. Minister of Ports and Airports Tomé Franca also participates in the event held in Ponta Porã.

item.title: A advertência do MPF à PRF sobre a eleição de 2026, 4 anos após as blitze bolsonaristas
item.description: The Federal Public Ministry (MPF) issued a warning to the Federal Highway Police (PRF) and Federal Police (PF) to ensure political neutrality in the 2026 elections, banning operations that hinder voter access to polling stations. The agencies have 60 days to report adopted measures, facing administrative and judicial sanctions for non-compliance. The warning comes four years after the 2022 Bolsonarist blitzes led by Silvinei Vasques, which were condemned by the Supreme Court as an illegal attempt to interfere in the election outcome.

item.title: Crise com Michelle: Eduardo replica posts defendendo Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro reposted social media content defending his brother Flávio Bolsonaro following a crisis involving Michelle Bolsonaro, who accused an 'overseas coordinated group' of daily attacks against her. Eduardo, who has lived in the U.S. since March 2025 and had his congressional mandate revoked, did not issue an official statement but indirectly supported Flávio by highlighting his empathetic and mature response to Michelle’s allegations. The ongoing tension between the stepchildren and former first lady persists, marked by public accusations and social media involvement from allies.

item.title: Dramalhão sem fim da família Bolsonaro pode afetar Flávio mais que caso Dark Horse
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro publicly attacked her stepson, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, claiming she had been disrespected, stabbed, and mistreated by him. The family feud intensifies internal political conflict within the Bolsonaro clan and may damage Flávio's image more than the Dark Horse case.

item.title: Ciro Gomes diz que 'não viu e não vai ver' vídeo de Michelle e que crise com Flávio Bolsonaro não envolve 'paróquia' local
item.description: Ciro Gomes (PSDB) said he did not see and will not watch Michelle Bolsonaro’s video about her clash with Flávio Bolsonaro, stating the issue is national, not local. He emphasized that the PL Ceará’s support for his gubernatorial bid is part of a Ceará emancipation project, separate from Bolsonarist internal conflicts. Michelle criticized the PL’s alliance with Ciro, arguing support should only come in a potential runoff, and defended Eduardo Girão (Novo) as the candidate aligned with Bolsonaro’s values.

item.title: Lula diz a Delcy que enviará "o que for necessário" para a Venezuela
item.description: President Lula stated that Brazil will send 'whatever is necessary' in humanitarian aid to Venezuela following two earthquakes that left 188 dead and nearly 40,000 missing. The assistance includes water, food, medicine, and deployment of Civil Defense and Fire Department teams, as agreed upon in a ministerial meeting and a conversation with Venezuela’s interim president Delcy Rodríguez.

item.title: Aceno aos evangélicos e legado de Bolsonaro: o que o cenário escolhido para vídeo de Michelle sinaliza
item.description: In the video published by Michelle Bolsonaro, she criticizes Senator Flávio Bolsonaro while positioning herself as the guardian of Bolsonaro's ideological legacy, appealing to female and evangelical voters with an empowered tone. The setting suggests a presidential office, signaling her readiness to assume a greater political role, despite being called an 'idiot' by her stepsons. The analysis highlights a paradox: her irreverence and pursuit of autonomy coexist with submission to the movement's ideological coherence.

item.title: Lula oferece ajuda à Venezuela após terremoto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva offered support to the Venezuelan government following a 7.5-magnitude earthquake that left at least 188 dead and 1,520 injured. In a phone call with interim president Delcy Rodríguez, Lula stated Brazil is ready to assist with relief and reconstruction efforts.

item.title: Caso Jaques Wagner vira coadjuvante nas redes diante da Copa e novela entre Michelle e Flávio
item.description: A video of Michelle Bolsonaro revealing strain in her relationship with Flávio Bolsonaro went viral on social media, generating nearly 4 million interactions in 24 hours. Despite the high engagement, the topic did not monopolize national attention, remaining a brief political footnote overshadowed by events such as the World Cup.

item.title: Datafolha: 79% dos brasileiros são favoráveis à redução da maioridade penal, aponta pesquisa
item.description: A Datafolha poll shows 79% of Brazilians support reducing the age of criminal responsibility to 16, though this is the lowest level in the historical series (previously reaching 87% in 2015). Support is higher among men (81%), Bolsonaro voters (90%), and those aged 25–44 (82%), while 61% favor the change for any crime and 39% only for heinous crimes.

item.title: Eleições 2026: TSE abre urna eletrônica para técnicos da Sociedade Brasileira de Computação
item.description: Representatives of the Brazilian Computing Society (SBC) conducted the second phase of inspecting the source code of the TSE’s electoral systems in Brasília on April 24–25, including the opening of an electronic voting machine and analysis of its internal mechanisms and software. The action is part of the Democratic Transparency Cycle – Elections 2026, promoted by Electoral Justice, aiming to ensure the security and reliability of the electoral process.

item.title: 'Vagabundo', 'miliciano' e mais: Flávio Bolsonaro faz queixa ao STF contra Janones
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for the presidency of Brazil, filed a criminal complaint with the Supreme Federal Court (STF) against federal deputy André Janones for alleged insult crimes in Instagram posts. The complaint cites five distinct episodes between March and June in which Janones used terms such as 'vagabundo', 'miliciano', 'thief', and 'worm' to refer to the senator, and stated he intended to 'bring down the level' and 'break the stick' against him. Bolsonaro's lawyers argue there is a repeated pattern of offensive behavior by Janones.

item.title: Eleições: Ex-ministro de Lula e Dilma sai em defesa de Marília Campos para o Senado em Minas Gerais
item.description: Deputy Patrus Ananias (PT-MG), former minister under Lula and Dilma, defended Marília Campos' Senate candidacy in Minas Gerais, stating she has effective chances to win. Campos, former mayor of Contagem, reiterated her sole availability is to run for Senate and that the PT fielding its own candidate for Minas governor would be a strategic mistake. Ananias said he will speak with Lula in the coming days and has been helping to find alternatives for the state gubernatorial race.

item.title: Deputado aciona MPSP contra consignados do governo no Digimais
item.description: State deputy Antonio Donato (PT) filed a representation with the MPSP to investigate alleged irregularities in the authorization of payroll loans by the Tarcísio de Freitas government to Banco Digimais, which was targeted by a Federal Police operation. The bank, linked to Bishop Edir Macedo (Republicanos), was authorized as a payroll lender in June 2025, despite prior rejection by the State Treasury. Donato requested the summoning of Secretary Caio Andrade to explain the decision before the São Paulo Legislative Assembly.

item.title: A investida de Salles contra parceiro de chapa de Tarcísio e Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Ricardo Salles (NOVO), pre-candidate for the Senate in São Paulo, claims he will surpass André do Prado (PL) in the 2026 election debates and interviews, despite currently ranking fourth in polls. Salles criticizes André do Prado for his ties to the 'centrão' and aims to attract bolsonarist voters dissatisfied with the ticket backed by Tarcísio de Freitas and Eduardo Bolsonaro.

item.title: Cúpula do Mercosul no Paraguai terá Lula, Milei e líderes de direita
item.description: The Mercosul summit in Asunción, Paraguay, will bring together Lula, Milei, and other regional leaders, including right-wing figures like Kast and Noboa, alongside associate members and international guests. Paraguay will hand over the bloc’s pro tempore presidency to Uruguay, and the agenda will focus on ongoing trade negotiations and deeper regional integration.

item.title: 'Piti de Michelle Bolsonaro é para implodir Flávio', diz aliado de Eduardo
item.description: Paulo Figueiredo claimed that Michelle Bolsonaro threw a 'tantrum' on social media to take Flávio Bolsonaro's place in the electoral race, as stated in his YouTube program. The commentator suggests the move was politically motivated to boost Michelle's candidacy at Flávio's expense.

item.title: Terremoto na Venezuela: Lula diz que conversou com Delcy Rodríguez e que vai enviar 'água, comida, remédio'
item.description: President Lula said he spoke with Venezuelan President Delcy Rodríguez about humanitarian aid following two powerful earthquakes that struck Venezuela on Wednesday (24), with magnitudes of 7.2 and 7.5. Brazil will send water, food, medicine, and deploy firefighters and civil defense teams. The disaster has left 188 dead, 1,520 injured, and 200 trapped under rubble, according to Venezuelan authorities.

item.title: PL aciona TSE e alega excesso de gastos em publicidade do governo Lula
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) has filed a complaint with the Superior Electoral Court (TSE) requesting the urgent suspension of government advertising campaigns under President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, alleging excessive spending on institutional propaganda that may constitute improper use of public resources for electoral gain. The PL argues such expenditures violate electoral law by creating unfair advantages for the ruling party ahead of the 2026 elections. The party seeks to ensure fairness in the upcoming electoral contest.

item.title: PT estuda senador Beto Faro para liderança do partido no Senado
item.description: The Workers' Party is considering Senator Beto Faro (PT-PA) to assume the party leadership in the Senate, replacing Teresa Leitão, who will become Government Leader. Faro is the favorite for the position, as he will not run for re-election in 2026, like Teresa, and his term runs until 2031. The decision will be made in a meeting of the PT Senate caucus on Tuesday, June 30, 2026, at 8:30 AM.

item.title: Após desavença, Flávio e Michelle Bolsonaro podem ter encontro próximo
item.description: PL members are anxious about a potential meeting between Flávio Bolsonaro and Michelle Bolsonaro after family tensions were exposed in a video posted by the stepmother on social media. The rift has raised concerns within the party about possible damage to the political cohesion of the Bolsonaro family. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: “Só unidos venceremos”, diz líder do PL após atrito entre Michelle e Flávio
item.description: PL Senate leader Carlos Portinho called for unity within the Bolsonarist camp following public tension between Michelle Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president. In a post on X, he stated 'we will only win united' and emphasized an appeal for cohesion. The statement aims to ease internal divisions ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Terras raras na reta final: Arnaldo Jardim vê barreira política perto do fim
item.description: Federal Deputy Arnaldo Jardim (Cidadania-SP), rapporteur of the bill regulating rare earth exploration in Brazil, expects Senate approval within the next two weeks once tensions between Senate President Davi Alcolumbre and President Lula are resolved. He announced he will not run for re-election in 2026, calling his fifth term his last, and said he will have more freedom to advance initiatives like the Rare Earth Legal Framework, PLP 100/2026 (Tariff Responsibility Law), ProFert, and PEC 34/2025 to end double taxation in the recycling sector.
